blocked_sentences: Unleash (You may have this creature enter with a +1/+1 counter on it. It can't block as long as it has a +1/+1 counter on it.)

needs.what: an unleash keyword: an optional 'may enter with a +1/+1 counter' replacement chosen as the creature enters (614.12, so it applies when granted by another permanent's static to a Dog entering), plus a linked 'can't block as long as it has a +1/+1 counter on it' static; grantable via a grant_keyword static to 'other Dogs you control'
needs.why_existing_wont_do: unleash is not in the keyword list. riot is the nearest keyword but offers haste as the alternative and has no can't-block rider. The cant_block static could cover the self rider, and enters_with_additional_counters is not optional, but 'Other Dogs you control have unleash' needs unleash as a grantable keyword whose entry replacement is applied to a permanent that is entering, which neither grant_keyword nor grant_ability (battlefield-only abilities) can carry
